verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ זָ֛ךְ שֶׁ֣מֶן כָּתִ֖ית זַ֥יִת לַמָּא֑וֹר נֵ֖ר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiq·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā zāḵ še·men kā·ṯîṯ za·yiṯ lam·mā·’ō·wr nêr lə·ha·‘ă·lōṯ tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Command - the Israelites . . . to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light to keep the lamps burning continually

verses.original: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד אַהֲרֹ֜ן יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ תָּמִ֑יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֛קֶר עוֹלָ֖ם חֻקַּ֥ת לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mi·ḥūṣ lə·p̄ā·rō·ḵeṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’a·hă·rōn ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’ō·ṯōw tā·mîḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh mê·‘e·reḇ ‘aḏ- bō·qer ‘ō·w·lām ḥuq·qaṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come

verses.original: יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־ הַנֵּר֑וֹת עַ֚ל הַטְּהֹרָ֔ה הַמְּנֹרָ֣ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’eṯ- han·nê·rō·wṯ ‘al haṭ·ṭə·hō·rāh ham·mə·nō·rāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: He shall tend - the lamps on the pure [gold] lampstand before the LORD continually

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְאָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת יִהְיֶ֖ה שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים הָאֶחָֽת׃ הַֽחַלָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā sō·leṯ wə·’ā·p̄î·ṯā ’ō·ṯāh šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ḥal·lō·wṯ yih·yeh šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm hā·’e·ḥāṯ ha·ḥal·lāh
verses.literal: You are also to take fine flour and bake - twelve . . . loaves using two-tenths of an ephah . . . for each loaf

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַטָּהֹ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’ō·w·ṯām šə·ta·yim ma·‘ă·rā·ḵō·wṯ šêš ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵeṯ ‘al haš·šul·ḥān haṭ·ṭā·hōr lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: and set them in two rows six per row on the table of pure gold before the LORD

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ זַכָּ֑ה לְבֹנָ֣ה עַל־ הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת וְהָיְתָ֤ה לְאַזְכָּרָ֔ה לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā zak·kāh lə·ḇō·nāh ‘al- ham·ma·‘ă·re·ḵeṯ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’az·kā·rāh lal·le·ḥem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עוֹלָֽם׃ בְּרִ֥ית
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ya·‘ar·ḵen·nū lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ mê·’êṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·w·lām bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: Every Sabbath day . . . . . . . . . the bread is to be set out before the LORD . . . . . . vvv on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֔יו וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ קָדֹ֑שׁ בְּמָק֣וֹם כִּ֡י ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw wa·’ă·ḵā·lu·hū qā·ḏōš bə·mā·qō·wm kî hū lōw qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: It belongs to Aaron and his sons who are to eat it in a holy place for it [is] to him a most holy [part] of the food offerings to the LORD [his] portion forever

verses.original: בֶּן־ יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְהוּא֙ בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֣ה מִצְרִ֔י אִ֣ישׁ וַיֵּצֵא֙ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃ וְאִ֖ישׁ
verses.transliteration: ben- yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ wə·hū ben- ’iš·šāh miṣ·rî ’îš way·yê·ṣê bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yin·nā·ṣū bam·ma·ḥă·neh ben hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lî wə·’îš
verses.literal: Now the son of an Israelite . . . mother and an Egyptian father went out among vvv the Israelites and a fight broke out in the camp [between him] . . . and an Israelite -

verses.original: בֶּן־ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית הָֽאִשָּׁ֨ה אֶת־ וַ֠יִּקֹּב הַשֵּׁם֙ וַיְקַלֵּ֔ל וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה אִמּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁ֥ם שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת־ דִּבְרִ֖י לְמַטֵּה־ דָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ben- hay·yiś·rə·’ê·lîṯ hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- way·yiq·qōḇ haš·šêm way·qal·lêl way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- mō·šeh ’im·mōw wə·šêm šə·lō·mîṯ baṯ- diḇ·rî lə·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān
verses.literal: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse So they brought him to Moses (His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri of the tribe of Dan

verses.original: וַיַּנִּיחֻ֖הוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ לִפְרֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם עַל־
verses.transliteration: way·yan·nî·ḥu·hū bam·miš·mār pî Yah·weh lip̄·rōš lā·hem ‘al-
verses.literal: They placed him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת־ הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָֽל־ הַשֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת־ וְסָמְכ֧וּ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ṣê ’eṯ- ham·qal·lêl ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ḵāl haš·šō·mə·‘îm ’eṯ- wə·sā·mə·ḵū yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- rō·šōw kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·rā·ḡə·mū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Take - the blasphemer - outside the camp and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head then have the whole assembly stone him

verses.original: וְאֶל־ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּֽי־ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- tə·ḏab·bêr lê·mōr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî- ’îš ’îš yə·qal·lêl ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·nā·śā ḥeṭ·’ōw
verses.literal: - And you are to tell . . . the Israelites . . . If anyone . . . curses his God he shall bear the consequences of his sin

verses.original: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־ יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ ב֖וֹ כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנָקְבוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·qêḇ šêm- Yah·weh mō·wṯ yū·māṯ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh rā·ḡō·wm yir·gə·mū- ḇōw kag·gêr kā·’ez·rāḥ bə·nā·qə·ḇōw- šêm yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death . . . the whole assembly must surely stone . . . him whether he is a foreign resident or native if he blasphemes the Name he must be put to death

verses.original: כִּ֥י וְאִ֕ישׁ יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kî wə·’îš yak·keh kāl- ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: And if a man takes the life of anyone else . . . . . . he must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶֽפֶשׁ־ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃ נֶ֖פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: ū·mak·kêh bə·hê·māh yə·šal·lə·men·nāh ne·p̄eš- ta·ḥaṯ nā·p̄eš ne·p̄eš
verses.literal: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution life for . . . life

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִ֕ישׁ יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’îš yit·tên mūm ba·‘ă·mî·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh kên yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: If anyone injures . . . his neighbor whatever he has done . . . must be done to him

verses.original: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: še·b̲er ta·ḥaṯ še·ḇer ‘a·yin ta·ḥaṯ ‘a·yin šên ta·ḥaṯ šên ka·’ă·šer yit·tên mūm bā·’ā·ḏām kên yin·nā·ṯen bōw
verses.literal: fracture for fracture eye for eye tooth for tooth Just as he injured . . . the other person the same must be inflicted on him

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mak·kêh ḇə·hê·māh yə·šal·lə·men·nāh ū·mak·kêh ’ā·ḏām yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution but whoever kills a man must be put to death

verses.original: יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם אֶחָד֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yeh lā·ḵem ’e·ḥāḏ miš·paṭ kag·gêr kā·’ez·rāḥ yih·yeh kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native . . . for I am the LORD your God

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- ham·qal·lêl ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yir·gə·mū ’ō·ṯōw ’ā·ḇen ū·ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites . . . and they took - the blasphemer vvv outside the camp and stoned - him So the Israelites . . . did as the LORD - had commanded Moses
